revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - See Sampson's comments. Use drop down menu for Koppa in lin1

Vote - AcceptText - This will require a careful set of eyes. Use recto/verso instead of columns; side A requires [.?] at the beginning of each line, and sometimes .1, too; I’d remove superfluous vac.? throughout; add number tags throughout; remove superfluous spaces within |reg| tags; in i.4 reformat the numeral (beta = 2,000, with a tick for thousands, chi has a tick after); in i.6 the alpha is printed with an overstroke; replace quotation marks in i.7 with superscript \ / (confirmed on image); in i.7 encode scribal diaeresis at start of line; image reveals .1 at start of i.8; in i.9 reformat the numeral (gamma = 3,000, with a tick for thousands, chi has a tick after); in i.10 the first letter is inside square brackets; only one tick on the numeral at the start of i.11; in i.11 >> (|κον.1|); side B requires [.?] at end of each line; use *slanting-stroke* twice on verso instead of //. I have probably missed some things.

Submit - I would like to submit this text in order to learn the procedure. I would also like to inform you that I accidentally submitted the same text (like P.Messeri 44) a few minutes ago. I apologize for that. Thank you.
